data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman 2035 in Marbella is a monumental achievement. After months of training and a gruelling race, your body and mind deserve the best recovery possible. A Marbella yacht charter for Ironman 2035 recovery offers the perfect blend of relaxation, gentle activity, and celebration – all from the comfort of a private boat departing from Puerto Banús. Whether you want to float in the Mediterranean, sip a cold drink, or simply lie in the sun, our fleet is ready to help you recharge.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for Ironman 2035 Recovery?

Post-race recovery isn’t just about rest – it’s about active recovery in a low-impact environment. A yacht charter lets you swim in calm coves, stretch on deck, and enjoy the sea air without the strain of running or cycling. The gentle motion of the boat can aid muscle relaxation, while the vitamin D from the Marbella sun supports your immune system. Plus, sharing the experience with family or friends makes it a memorable reward for your effort.

Our Fleet for Post-Race Relaxation

We offer a range of boats suitable for different group sizes and budgets. For small groups of up to 5, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are cost-effective options. For larger support crews, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) provide ample deck space and shade. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks – you just turn up and relax.

Pricing That Fits Your Recovery Budget

Our Tier A boats – the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 – start at €749 for 2 hours, rising to €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. This price includes skipper, drinks, and VAT. For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 minimum 4 hours) even includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp, so we can tailor a package to your needs. No hidden fees – just straightforward pricing.

Best Anchorages for Recovery Swimming and Relaxation

Our skippers know the Costa del Sol intimately. Top recovery spots include Cala del Faro – a sheltered cove with crystal-clear water – and Cala Cortés, ideal for gentle swimming. For a longer cruise, head towards Cabopino or Estepona, where you can anchor in quiet bays away from the crowds. Each anchorage offers calm conditions perfect for floating and unwinding.

What’s Included in Your Charter

Every booking comes with a fully licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You don’t need to bring anything except your swimwear, sunscreen, and a towel. If you have specific dietary needs for post-race recovery, feel free to bring your own food – our crew will store it for you.

How to Book Your Ironman 2035 Recovery Charter

We recommend booking at least 2–4 weeks in advance, as Ironman week is busy in Puerto Banús. Simply contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and duration. We’ll confirm availability and send you a booking link. All major payment methods accepted. After the race, you deserve the best – let us help you recover in style.

Yes, we offer 2-hour, 4-hour, 6-hour, and 8-hour charters. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 start at €749 for 2 hours, perfect for a quick post-race dip and drinks. Longer charters let you explore the coast and relax properly.

What’s included in the charter price for Ironman recovery?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Just bring your swimwear and a towel – we handle the rest.

How many people can join the yacht for recovery?

Our fleet accommodates from 5 to 12 passengers. Popular choices for groups include the Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) and Mangusta 80 (12 pax). For smaller groups, the Dubhe (5 pax) or Speedboat (6 pax) are ideal.

Do I need to book in advance for Ironman 2035 week?

Yes, we recommend booking at least 2–4 weeks ahead, especially for larger yachts. Ironman week is busy in Puerto Banús. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability and secure your preferred boat.

Can we anchor for swimming and snorkelling during recovery?

Absolutely. Skippers know the best spots like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés for calm, clear water. You can swim, snorkel, or just float – all equipment is provided on board.

Is there a minimum age or fitness requirement for the charter?

No minimum age – families with children are welcome. For Ironman athletes, the yacht is designed for relaxation. Just ensure all passengers can safely board the boat. Life jackets are available for all sizes.

What happens if the weather is bad on recovery day?

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we’ll reschedule or offer a full refund. Marbella enjoys 300+ sunny days a year, so weather disruptions are rare.

Can I bring my own food or special recovery meals on board?

Yes, you’re welcome to bring your own food. We provide light snacks, but if you need specific recovery nutrition, bring it along. Our crew can also recommend local catering options if you prefer.
